svanstj7.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
svanstj7.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
svanstj7.sourceDescription: Bring the magic of the holiday season into your home with this Artificial Christmas Tree, designed in the classic Art Deco style. This cone-shaped decorative piece is perfect for living rooms, gardens, and terraces, offering a vibrant green tone with a luxuriant appearance. The tree's 8 LED flash modes bring warmth and festivity, thanks to the integrated decorative string lights and USB power source that make it both stylish and easy to operate. A lovely addition to your holiday décor, evoking the timeless charm of Christmas. Premium Materials: Crafted from durable PVC and sturdy iron, this artificial tree promises longevity and resilience, standing strong and vibrant throughout the holiday season. The PVC material ensures a lush and realistic foliage appearance, while the iron frame supports and stabilizes its structure, making it a dependable centerpiece for seasonal celebrations. Illuminated Charm: Fitted with warm white LED lights and decorative strings, the tree creates an inviting glow. These energy-efficient lights are evenly spaced, offering consistent illumination and setting a serene holiday mood across any room. Conveniently controlled via USB, altering lighting patterns is effortlessly achieved to enhance different times of day or moods. Collapsible Design: Its innovative, fully collapsible construction facilitates painless assembly and disassembly. Approach storage with ease; once the festivities conclude, the tree neatly folds up, making it practical for those with limited storage space. Stylish Features: Inspired by the opulence of Art Deco, this tree's design adds grandeur to its surroundings, lending an air of sophistication. This striking piece allows you to embellish with ribbons and ornaments, inviting your creativity each year. Care Instructions: Maintain its sheen by wiping with a dry cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals to preserve its elegant matte finish. Such simple care guarantees that it maintains its brilliance and grace year after year, prolonging joy and holiday tradition. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 60 cm Stand size: 50.5cm Collapsible Light Weight Durable Portable Lifelike Decorate with ribbons,bows and flowers Pop-Up Number of baubles: 56 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED light string 1 x Pack of tree decoration DO NOT connect this chain electrically to another chain. The lamps are not replaceable. If product is used outdoors, the USB should be plugged in indoors, in dry environment. This item is not a toy and should be used for decorative purposes only. The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Please note to use only certified DC 5V input. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fire. The flexible cable of the string light cannot be replaced, and do not use the string light if the cable is damaged.Do not connect the LED lamp to the certified 5V USB power source while installing and maintaining. This appliance must not be used by children under 14 years and persons with reduced physical, sensory or mental capabilities or lack of experience and knowledge concerning the use of electronic appliances. Do not operate this product near explosives or flammable liquids, gases and dust. Do not operate the product in the extreme temperatures. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

Flexible wired branches allow the garland to be shaped and arranged around mantelpieces, staircases, doorways, shelves and other Christmas displays. REUSABLE CHRISTMAS DECOR: Durable seasonal construction allows the garland to be carefully stored and reused year after year. ht9j1a3b.baseName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Red Tinsel
ht9j1a3b.variantName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Red Tinsel
ht9j1a3b.sourceDescription: Make a real statement this Christmas with our 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Red Tinsel. Combining a full 8-ply construction with an impressive 12cm thickness, it provides substantially more volume and visual impact than standard tinsel, making it particularly effective for larger Christmas trees and festive displays. The vibrant metallic red finish catches and reflects the surrounding light beautifully, creating the unmistakable sparkle of traditional Christmas tinsel. Its mixture of reflective strands creates a rich, full appearance that stands out particularly well against green Christmas foliage. Supplied in a generous continuous 50m length, you can use the tinsel as one long run or simply cut it into the individual lengths required for your display. This makes it particularly useful for larger decorating projects and allows you to decorate multiple areas without having to join together lots of shorter retail-sized lengths. The tinsel is also fire retardant, making it a practical choice for commercial festive displays as well as decorating around the home. Whether you're wrapping a large Christmas tree, decorating railings and displays or creating a substantial commercial installation, this extra thick red tinsel provides plenty of length, coverage and festive sparkle to create an impressive traditional Christmas display. Product Features • 50m extra thick red tinsel • Full 8-ply construction • Generous 12cm thickness • Bright metallic red finish • Highly reflective for maximum festive impact • Supplied in one continuous 50m length • Easily cut to your required lengths • Fire retardant • Ideal for large Christmas trees and displays • Perfect for domestic and commercial decorating Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB
